# LayoutFooterShowcase - LayoutFooter is a fixed footer slot within a Layout, pinned to the bottom for persistent actions like form buttons or navigation.
# Components: Card, Center, Layout

<Center width={400}>
  <Layout hasDivider height="fill">
    /* header: */
    <LayoutHeader hasDivider>
      <Card variant="muted" />
    </LayoutHeader>
    /* start: */
    <LayoutPanel hasDivider width={140}>
      <Card variant="muted" />
    </LayoutPanel>
    /* content: */
    <LayoutContent>
      <Card variant="muted" />
    </LayoutContent>
    /* footer: */
    <LayoutFooter hasDivider>
      <HStack gap={2}>
        <Button variant="secondary" />
        <Button variant="primary" />
      </HStack>
    </LayoutFooter>
